items.t: Diesel emissions faults, limp mode and DEF countdown
items.job: Replace a failed NOx sensor (common cause; confirm by diagnosis first)
items.note: Price covers one NOx sensor, a frequent cause. A DEF heater, pump or other fault costs differently, so get the fault confirmed first. Owners on CarGurus report $1,400-$1,600 dealer quotes for NOx sensor work; check whether the federal 8-year/80,000-mile emissions warranty still covers your van. Parts and hours from MB Medic OM642 repair table.

items.t: Leaking injector seals cause "black death" sludge
items.job: Remove injector, clean the bore and fit a new copper seal (per injector)
items.note: Priced per injector. Seized injectors, several leaking cylinders or a damaged bore cost much more. Parts and hours from MB Medic OM642 repair table; procedure per Mercedes "black death" service article.

items.t: Intake swirl flaps stick and cause limp mode
items.job: Clean intake manifolds and replace swirl rods/linkage, or replace manifolds
items.note: Low end is cleaning plus repair parts (IDParts: under $400 in parts); high end is both genuine manifolds (AutohausAZ: about $540 left, $705 right). Hours from MB Medic intake manifold clean (3-6 h).

items.t: Oil cooler seals leak into the engine valley
items.job: Replace oil cooler seals (Viton) and related gaskets
items.note: Low end is genuine seals and gaskets (about $4 per seal at MB Parts Giant; MB Medic $30-80); high end is a complete Rein seal kit (about C$278). IDParts puts the job at 8-10 shop hours; MB Medic lists 12-14. Replacing the cooler itself adds parts cost. MB Medic: $1,500-2,200 independent, $2,500-3,500 dealer.

items.t: Shudder like driving over rumble strips
items.job: Transmission fluid, filter and connector adapter service
items.note: A torque converter or rebuild costs much more if the service doesn't cure it.

items.t: Engine just clicks and won't crank
items.note: RepairPal puts a starter at about $550-1,600 total depending on year. Check cables and relay first.

items.t: Intake or intercooler hoses come loose
Exhaust flex pipe breaks
items.job: Weld in a replacement flex coupling
items.note: Parts: Miller CAT 2.1L and 3.0L Sprinter flex kits ($125 sale, $175 regular), welded in by a shop. Hours based on ClickMechanic's Sprinter front pipe time (about 1 hour); welding may add a little. Check that hot exhaust has not melted nearby wiring.
